id: title:Gilbert09:stop reporting first over budget repartition as failed

review.posthog_relevance: Adds exception state tracking to distinguish checkpoint recovery from workflow restarts, supporting reliability and recovery diagnostics.
review.reason: Adds two boolean attributes to an exception class and assigns them based on checkpoint state, establishing a mechanism to distinguish between a workflow restart and a checkpoint recovery. This supports the reliability and recovery diagnostics of the workflow.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation of state tracking, not on verified production outcomes or adoption. The benefit is inferred from the code's ability to distinguish recovery states, not from demonstrated incident avoidance or user benefit.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are inferred. No tier is assigned; this chunk is not scored.

observations.behavior: Adds two new exception attributes, had_prior_checkpoint and checkpoint_saved, to RepartitionBudgetExceededError and their assignment in the workflow.
observations.posthog_connection: These attributes distinguish a first attempt that saved a checkpoint from a treadmill restart, preventing false failure classification.

observations.behavior: Assigns had_prior_checkpoint and checkpoint_saved to the exception instance based on checkpoint state.
observations.posthog_connection: Records whether a checkpoint existed at the start of this attempt, distinguishing progress from a restart.

observations.behavior: Assigns checkpoint_saved to the exception instance after checkpointing the half-built temp.
observations.posthog_connection: Records whether this attempt persisted a checkpoint the next run can resume from, establishing forward progress.
